videos.title: Incoherent sum of speckles
videos.description: Coherent light passing through a scattering medium is scrambled into a speckle pattern. But if there are multiple sources incoherent with each other, the resulting pattern will be the incoherent sum of the speckle patterns generated by each source.
videos.artist: Jacopo Bertolotti
videos.credit: https://twitter.com/j_bertolotti/status/1553005005304696832

videos.title: Rolling Racers - Moment of inertia (HD)
videos.description: An object's moment of inertia I determines how much it resists rotational motion. In this simulation, four objects are placed on a ramp and left to roll without slipping. Starting from rest, each will experience an angular acceleration based on their moment of inertia.
videos.artist: Lucas V. Barbosa
videos.credit: Own work
